mapper.sql: select m.id, m.cas_number, m.msds_code, m.product_name, m.product_alias, m.product_english_name, m.category_id, m.company_name, m.company_address, m.zip_code, m.fax_number, m.contact_phone, m.email, m.emergency_phone, m.recommended_usage, m.restricted_usage, m.version, m.revision_date, m.effective_date, m.status, m.approver, m.approval_date, m.is_active, m.create_time, m.update_time, m.remark from msds_main m left join msds_document_statistics s on m.id = s.msds_id

when.test: filters != null and filters.sortBy != null and filters.sortBy == 'updated'
filters != null and filters.sortBy != null and filters.sortBy == 'name'
filters != null and filters.sortBy != null and filters.sortBy == 'views'

mapper.select: where m.is_active = 1 and m.cas_number like concat('%', #{casNumber}, '%') order by m.create_time desc
where m.is_active = 1 order by m.create_time desc

where m.is_active = 1 and (m.product_name like concat('%', #{name}, '%') or m.product_alias like concat('%', #{name}, '%') or m.product_english_name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')) order by m.create_time desc
where m.is_active = 1 and m.company_name like concat('%', #{supplier}, '%') order by m.create_time desc

m.is_active = 1
AND m.product_name like concat('%', #{filters.productName}, '%')
AND m.cas_number like concat('%', #{filters.casNumber}, '%')
AND m.company_name like concat('%', #{filters.companyName}, '%')
AND m.category_id = #{filters.categoryId}
AND m.status = #{filters.status}
order by m.create_time desc

SELECT DISTINCT m.product_name as name, m.cas_number as casNumber, m.product_english_name as englishName FROM msds_main m WHERE m.is_active = 1 AND ( m.product_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.product_alias like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.product_english_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.cas_number like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT m.*, s.view_count FROM msds_main m LEFT JOIN msds_document_statistics s ON m.id = s.msds_id WHERE m.is_active = 1 AND m.id != #{msdsId} AND ( m.category_id = (SELECT category_id FROM msds_main WHERE id = #{msdsId}) OR m.company_name = (SELECT company_name FROM msds_main WHERE id = #{msdsId}) ) ORDER BY s.view_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
